content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in early 2025 (e.g., 2025-03-07, 2025-01-16/17) — adjust downward bias for recent periods.
- Overestimates after sharp price spikes (e.g., 2025-01-16: forecast peaks at 82.11 vs true 82.95) — cap forecast after spike to avoid overshoot.
- Underestimates in mid-2024 (e.g., 2024-06-17/18) — model misses upward momentum; increase baseline by 1–2% for mid-year data.
- Mean reversion bias: model holds too long in high/low zones — add smoothing or momentum decay factor.
- Lagged response: model reacts too slowly to recent price drops (e.g., 2025-03-07: true drops below 70, model still above 70) — adjust for 3–5 day lag correction.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts overestimate volatility in 2025 Q1 — reduce forecast variance by 15–20% for early-year data.
